newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks lower in subdued London trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks lower in subdued London trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks eased in London on Monday following declines earlier in Tokyo, traders here said.

The Nikkei 50 index of leading Japanese shares in London was down 23.28 points at 1,453.13 by 1540 GMT, after the benchmark Nikkei 225 dropped 345.67 points to 20,674.69 in Tokyo as a recent boom in blue chips faded.
Dealers said the market could drift down further to test recent lows, though some buying interest had emerged in subdued trade.
"Stocks fell too much overnight, so people were looking to pick them up in low volume," one dealer said.
"I think we've probably got another week when the market will just drift lower, but if we touch recent lows then you'll get some buying interest again," another dealer said.

The dealers said the market in Tokyo sold off aggressively in the last hour or so of trading. "Some of those stocks were a bit overdone. We've seen some fairly good bids in London but no real interest," one dealer said.
Some heavy industry stocks were quite well bid, while blue chips were fairly mixed, with selling in NEC and buyers of Fujitsu.
"There has been a little bit of buying interest in some bank names which have been weak recently," one dealer said, mentioning Mitsubishi Bank.
However, he said Nikkei futures in Chicago were trading below cash levels and the market had been down for the past four sessions. "I wouldn't expect any real buying just yet," he added.
